neighbours.label: The token ' following' as a determiner-like adjective pointing ahead ('the following conditions'), not the verb or the word's other senses
fire: Applicants must meet the following requirements before the committee reviews any forms.
Licensed users may share this file if the following rules are observed by everyone.
To finish the installation, please run the following commands in a new terminal.
Our study group agreed to answer the following questions before the next lesson.
Staff are reminded that the following items cannot be taken into the laboratory.
You can reach the office during the following hours on any normal working day.
Readers should keep the following points in mind when they reach the last chapter.
Refunds will only be granted under the following circumstances, as the contract states.
quiet: Applicants must pay the small fee before the committee reviews any forms.
Licensed users may share this file if the owner is told by everyone.
To finish the installation, please close all other programs in a new terminal.
Our study group agreed to answer some easy questions before the next lesson.

You can reach the office during normal hours on any working day.
Readers should keep a pencil in hand when they reach the last chapter.
Refunds will only be granted under rare circumstances, as the contract states.

notes: The card flags this pole broad, and ' following' peaks only 2 of its top 32 activations, so the trigger is expected to cover little of the pole. In probes ' same' and ' certain' were much weaker than ' following'.
